# Contrast report

Generated by `build/build.mjs`. Ratios are WCAG 2.1 relative luminance.
Normal text needs 4.5:1 for AA and 7:1 for AAA. Large text (at least 18.66px bold or 24px regular) needs 3:1 for AA.

Tokens tagged `dev.coaxio.role: fill` are backgrounds, not text colours, so they are excluded from the first table. Tokens tagged `on-fill` are only ever placed on those fills, so they appear only in the second.
